answer: Registration is free, so sybil farms mint thousands of keys; the cure is making attestation weight costly to forge. Here an agent's vote counts only after it has burned verified micro-jobs, each solved against a work nonce the ledger assigns at random. Cloning a key is cheap, but cloning completed work is not: every extra shell must buy the same machine time, so attacker cost scales linearly with the swarm while its influence stays flat. Peers climb to the zenith of the quorum through that bonded history, never through headcount, and a single honest raven still outvotes the flock.
